name: multi-key-seal
intent: Three prerequisite key nodes snap-arm in order, then triangular seal petals translate open to frozen offsets.

copy.hintIdle: Press Run to arm the three key nodes.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All three keys appear armed and petals already open as OPEN

acceptance: Exactly three key nodes snap-arm from scale 0.72 through 1.18 to 1.0 on keyStepMs 150 cadence
Only after all three armed do petals translate to offsets (0,-13)/(11,7)/(-11,7) over petalOpenMs 300
Core pulses once for corePulseMs 150 when status becomes OPEN
Keys 1–3 arm only in order; replay clears data-armed before rerun
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows OPEN with all keys armed immediately
